en.headline: Fire at Richland Gardens in Kowloon Bay evacuates about 150 residents
en.dek: Three people were taken to hospital for suspected smoke inhalation after a blaze broke out in a low-floor unit early on Wednesday.
body: A fire broke out in a unit on a lower floor of Block 22 at Richland Gardens in Kowloon Bay at about 3.15am on Wednesday, prompting the evacuation of about 150 residents, police and firefighters said.
Fire Services personnel arrived and extinguished the blaze. A resident on the 10th floor waved a towel from a window for assistance and was later helped out by firefighters.
Three people were taken to hospital for suspected smoke inhalation. They were conscious. An elderly resident needed help descending the stairs but did not require hospital treatment.
Firefighters are investigating the cause. Initial reports indicated the fire may have been linked to an overheating power strip. There is no indication of criminal involvement at this stage.

zh.headline: 九龍灣麗晶花園單位火警 約150名住客疏散
zh.dek: 周三凌晨低層單位起火，三人懷疑吸入濃煙送院，消防正調查起火原因。
body: 警方及消防表示，周三凌晨約三時十五分，九龍灣麗晶花園第22座一個低層單位發生火警，約150名住客需要疏散。
消防到場將火勢救熄。期間一名10樓住客在窗邊揮動毛巾求助，其後由消防員協助離開。
三人因懷疑吸入濃煙被送往醫院治理，他們均保持清醒。一名老翁需他人攙扶下樓，但毋須送院。
消防正調查起火原因。初步了解顯示，火警或與插蘇過熱有關。現階段沒有證據顯示涉及刑事成分。
